Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
Job Summary: 
 As a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack), you will work collaboratively within an Agile environment to deliver customer-facing user experiences that empower self-service analytics, monitoring, and configuration for critical B2B commerce operations. With an emphasis on reliability, quality, security, and customer outcomes, the endpoint solutions you deliver will directly contribute to customer success and help drive TradeCentric’s next phase of growth.
 💻 Report To: Sr. Software Engineering Manager
 🏢 Work Location: Bucharest, Romania (Hybrid schedule)
 📅 Schedule: Monday to Friday (In-office Tues.–Thurs., remote Mon./Fri.)
 🕒 Hours: 9am to 6pm
 What You'll Do: 
Research, design, develop, test, and deploy software solutions for your area
Champion quality and meet quality requirements for all work, including unit test development, adherence to quality gates, and contribution to test plans
Serve as technical lead for multi-contributor projects
Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers
Lead root cause analysis and resolution of critical production issues
Collaborate with peers and stakeholders in all aspects of Agile and other team ceremonies
Drive technical research and evaluation of new tools, frameworks, and methodologies
Champion and lead continuous improvement initiatives
Evaluate and pilot emerging AI-assisted engineering tools and share learnings with the team to improve collective velocity.
 Who You Are: 
Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is strongly preferred
6-9 years of software engineering experience
Full-stack development with focus on scalable, secure applications
 Backend: PHP 8+, Laravel, API development, unit testing
 Frontend: Vue.js 3+, responsive UI development
 Databases: MySQL/MariaDB (additionally Elasticsearch, Logstash & MongoDB preferred)
Adept at working with Git (GitHub Actions a plus), containers (Docker), and Apache/Linux
Preferred: TypeScript, Zend/Laminas frameworks
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (Claude, GitHub Copilot or similar) to streamline coding, debugging, and testing workflows.
An eagerness to explore and leverage AI-driven tools and emerging technologies to enhance software development efficiency and drive innovation.
Creative problem-solver
A great teammate. Confident and passionate, yet humble and empathetic
A champion and practitioner of Agile’s principle qualities
 About Us: 
 TradeCentric is a leading innovator at the crossroads of eCommerce and eProcurement, transforming how B2B buyers and suppliers connect, automate, and scale their operations. Recognized for our rapid growth, TradeCentric has earned a place on the INC. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in America for the three consecutive years. Backed by private equity, we continue to expand our best-in-class B2B Connected Commerce solutions and technology platform to enable frictionless trade for thousands of businesses worldwide.
 Our purpose-built solution integrates with every leading eCommerce and eProcurement/ERP system to help suppliers and buyers seamlessly automate and accelerate their mission-critical transactions. By eliminating the complexity of disconnected systems, TradeCentric drives efficiency, lowers costs, and powers growth for our partners.
